data.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: vertical 2:3 Pinterest-native editorial image, base photograph for a later restrained magazine headline
Primary request: Create a believable, beautifully styled late-1970s corporate presentation room after hours. The exact loose tabletop sound button from Image 1 sits on the moderator's walnut console as if it is the meeting's referee. The scene should feel like quietly funny workplace editorial photography, never an advertisement.
Input images: Image 1 is the sole product-truth reference. Use only the loose product shown on the right side of the reference, not its yellow retail package and not the pressing finger. Preserve one ordinary five-inch-wide tabletop device: one glossy red hemispherical dome, the existing white uppercase product word BULLSHIT centered on the dome, one low circular gray plastic base, and the small black speaker vents around the base. This existing word is product labeling, not added campaign copy.
Scene/backdrop: empty warm modernist corporate presentation room, walnut console, softly out-of-focus rows of rust and olive chairs, a deep muted olive acoustic wall, one closed cream agenda with no visible writing, one pencil. No people.
Subject: the exact red-and-gray button rests loose and flat on the console at believable five-inch scale. It must not be built into the furniture and must be large enough to inspect.
Style/medium: highly realistic editorial interior photography, subtle 35mm film grain, period-aware but not costume-like, tactile and sophisticated.
Composition/framing: vertical 2:3; console and button in the lower-middle; natural calm dark wall in the upper third for later typography; asymmetric magazine composition rather than a centered product shot. The button is narratively important but not giant.
Lighting/mood: warm side light from one practical lamp with soft falloff, quiet room after a long meeting, restrained deadpan humor.
Color palette: walnut, deep olive, rust, cream, one saturated red product accent.
Text: retain only the real product label BULLSHIT on the button exactly once. No other text, captions, headlines, logos, badges, watermarks, signs, screens, or legible agenda copy.
Constraints: exactly one button; exact loose-product silhouette and colors; believable tabletop scale; physically grounded; no hand; no package; no implied powered detector; no emergency-control mounting; no CTA, price, border, collage, product card, or ad layout.
Avoid: game-show scale, emergency stop button, wall-mounted alarm, huge architectural object, duplicated button, incorrect word, pseudo-text, glowing sci-fi control, brand campaign polish, generic AI gloss.
notes: Generated from the exact Amazon source image and inspected at full useful resolution.
This is the selected contextual base for the deterministic headline treatment.
